fields.description: Bit per save file marking it saved through the per-slot path; set via (1 << slot) in FUN_0803108c, tested as occupied bits (0x01/0x02/0x04) in FUN_0802e188. Zero here = factory-init image (FUN_08031208 never sets bits).
fields.evidence: FUN_0803108c does *(byte *)(DAT_080310e0 + 0xe) |= (1 << param_1) before EEPROM write; FUN_0802e188 tests (byte)(iVar4 + 0xe) & 1 / & 2 / & 4 for slot 0/1/2 occupied. Baseline logical byte 0x00.
fields.name: slots_occupied_flags

fields.description: File index stored inside slot 0; written as the init parameter.
fields.evidence: FUN_08030f4c writes *(byte *)((int)puVar2 + 0x36) = param_1 where puVar2 = slot * 0x48 + DAT_08030fc4. Baseline logical slot0+0x36 = 0x00.
fields.name: slot0_file_index

fields.description: Raw progress counter for slot 0; file-select tier shown = counter / 5 (quotient via FUN_080396e8), tier 4 clamped to 3. Factory default 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802e188 computes FUN_080396e8(*(byte *)(base + 0x47), 5) with 0x48-strided slot array (header-relative +0x47 = slot-relative +0x37), clamping tier 4 to 3; FUN_08030f4c zeroes slot +0x1e..+0x31 (covers +0x37). Baseline logical slot0+0x37 = 0x00.
fields.name: slot0_progress_count

fields.description: Slot-independent setting byte; carried over from the active work slot across file switches instead of being replaced by the loaded file. Factory default 1.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802e2cc saves DAT_0802e328 + 0x39 across FUN_0803102c slot load then restores it; FUN_08030f4c sets slot +0x39 = 1. Baseline logical slot0+0x39 = 0x01.
fields.name: slot0_setting_a
